components.label: Collection, refresh, search and pagination
components.behavior: The browser fetches Tasks, Dashboard selections, Goals, Milestones and series; a latest-request guard prevents old responses replacing newer reads. Page size is 8, or 4 below 600px. Tags currently have a hidden filter control.

tests.symbol: test('task filtering treats search text literally and preserves server order'
tests.label: task filtering

tests.symbol: test('a page shrinks safely after filtering or its final row is removed'
tests.label: page shrinks

components.label: Task row: tick, dates, week, Edit, Remove, Important
components.behavior: Rows are built in JavaScript. Complete/Reopen uses shared acknowledgement handling; the week button changes selection, Important changes importance, and Remove archives. Inspect the row builder before changing icons or interaction order.

components.label: Today
components.behavior: Includes a local deadline/start/occurrence date equal to today, a scheduled interval covering today, or unfinished overdue work. History-qualified work is excluded before membership is evaluated.

tests.symbol: test('scheduled tasks cross UTC midnight into the account date, independently of deadline and week selection'
tests.label: scheduled tasks cross UTC

tests.symbol: test('unfinished tasks overdue for fewer than three dates stay in Today until History takes them'
tests.label: unfinished tasks overdue

tests.symbol: test('today includes an interval crossing midnight, a planned start date, and a recurring occurrence'
tests.label: today includes an interval

components.label: Next
components.behavior: Includes any future deadline/start/occurrence/scheduled date, including scheduled end. A Task can appear in both Today and Next.

tests.symbol: test('scheduled tasks cross UTC midnight into the account date, independently of deadline and week selection'
tests.label: scheduled tasks cross UTC

tests.symbol: test('today includes an interval crossing midnight, a planned start date, and a recurring occurrence'
tests.label: today includes an interval

components.label: This week
components.behavior: Membership is the current Monday-week Task selection set, not a due-date query. Completion does not automatically remove a selection.

tests.symbol: test('scheduled tasks cross UTC midnight into the account date, independently of deadline and week selection'
tests.label: scheduled tasks cross UTC

components.label: Backlog
components.behavior: No deadline, start, occurrence or schedule date and not selected this week. Inbox is a parent/location concept and is independent of Backlog.

tests.symbol: test('backlog preserves inbox tasks but excludes selected and overdue tasks without inventing status'
tests.label: backlog preserves inbox

components.label: All
components.behavior: All fetched Tasks that do not qualify for History, then the independent search/status/tag filters. The default Open tasks status still hides Done Tasks.

tests.symbol: test('backlog preserves inbox tasks but excludes selected and overdue tasks without inventing status'
tests.label: backlog preserves inbox

components.label: Status and count badges
components.behavior: Stored Task statuses are NotStarted, InProgress, Blocked and Done. Open tasks excludes Done. Count badges apply the same view membership plus active search/status/tag filters; Repeating counts non-Ended series instead.

tests.symbol: test('task filtering treats search text literally and preserves server order'
tests.label: task filtering

tests.symbol: test('each view count applies its own status rule so open filtering cannot zero Completed'
tests.label: each view count

components.label: Completed section and History boundary
components.behavior: Under the default Open tasks filter, recently Done Tasks appear in a separate section. History uses configurable elapsed completed-hours and local overdue-days thresholds. This is a projection; pruning is a separate server job.

tests.symbol: test('each view count applies its own status rule so open filtering cannot zero Completed'
tests.label: each view count

tests.symbol: test('history uses elapsed completion time and local calendar overdue dates'
tests.label: history uses elapsed

components.label: Inbox, Goal or Milestone parent
components.behavior: A Task has at most one Goal or Milestone parent; no parent is Inbox. Completed finite Goal ancestors reject new finite work. The server validates owned destinations even if the select was edited in the browser.

components.label: Task fields and estimates
components.behavior: The shared PHP partial renders schedule-related fields. Browser input is normalized by taskCaptureValues; server create/update validators enforce field bounds, unknown-key rejection and date ordering. Estimates represent planned minutes, not tracked time.

components.label: Due date, reminder and repeat picker
components.behavior: The schedule toolbar supplies presets and a draggable date picker. One-off capture POSTs a Task; repeat capture POSTs a TaskSeries. seriesPayload is the exact mapping boundary: do not assume every one-off field is copied into a series.

tests.symbol: test('repeat choices become task-series rules, including custom intervals'
tests.label: repeat choices

tests.symbol: test('reminder presets use 7 PM later today and 9 AM for tomorrow and next week'
tests.label: reminder presets

components.label: Repeating list: Pause, Resume, End
components.behavior: Rows show series state, frequency, start/end and optional reminder time. Pause retains existing Tasks. Resume skips missed paused dates; End asks to archive future NotStarted occurrences, preserving started/Done work. Ended is terminal: API Pause/Resume returns 422 after ownership/version checks; repeated End with the current version is a no-op. Start a new series for future repeating work.

components.label: Daily, weekly, monthly and yearly rules
components.behavior: Date calculation uses local calendar dates. Monthly/yearly dates clamp from the original anchor. Weekly carries weekdays. Local-time conversion resolves DST; the series/date unique key prevents duplicate occurrences. Preview calculates dates without querying or writing series/occurrence rows. Supported browser timezone aliases are canonicalized even when PHP accepts the alias directly; previously accepted fixed-offset forms keep their existing fallback behavior.

components.label: Initial and catch-up materialization
components.behavior: HTTP creation materializes immediately. The scheduler materializes hourly; Task listing and Dashboard reads also call materializeDue when the generated horizon is below 28 days. This read-path side effect is current code behavior. Generated work is excluded from finite Goal progress.

components.label: Overview and Edit dialog
components.behavior: Edits use a separate DraftBuffer. A save acknowledges only the submitted snapshot, retains newer typing and handles 409 through explicit saved/draft choices. Initial controls remain disabled until data loads.

tests.symbol: test('a late save acknowledgement preserves typing after the submitted snapshot'
tests.label: late save acknowledgement

tests.symbol: test('refresh cannot erase or silently rebase a dirty goal draft'
tests.label: refresh cannot erase

components.test_scope: The linked JavaScript cases exercise shared DraftBuffer semantics, not this page’s DOM/editor wiring. Verify the page flow separately in a browser.

components.label: Complete and Reopen
components.behavior: Unchecked Checklist items require explicit acknowledgement. Completing a Task never checks items automatically. Reopening finite work beneath completed Goal ancestors asks to reopen those ancestors atomically. A locked Milestone does not block its Tasks.

components.label: Completion Checklist
components.behavior: Checklist records are separate owned/versioned rows. Check/uncheck writes Activity; order is a complete-ID-set mutation. This is distinct from inline checkable text in a working note.

components.label: Working note, Check box and Resources
components.behavior: The Task note uses explicit Save. Linking/creating the owned Note is handled by saveTaskNote; text persists through the Note API. Resource URLs are derived from plain note text. There is no promise of browser-crash recovery for this explicit-save editor.

tests.symbol: test('projection preserves literal markup, Unicode, whitespace, and malformed markers exactly'
tests.label: projection preserves

tests.symbol: test('toggling duplicate titles targets only its line and never changes literal note text'
tests.label: toggling duplicate titles

components.label: Tags, week selection and Related work
components.behavior: Tags and contributions classify or relate work without changing its primary location. Week selection controls This week; contributions do not affect progress.

components.label: Manage Areas
components.behavior: Accounts start with localized placeholder Areas. Rename/reorder uses owner/version checks; at most four active Areas and the last active Area cannot be archived. An Area containing active root Goals cannot be archived.

components.label: Goal tree, timeline and main Goal
components.behavior: Goal hierarchy has one primary Area or parent Goal and arbitrary depth. Tree/timeline presentation does not alter it. Create/move validates ownership, active ancestors and cycles. Open a Goal name for its fishbone.

components.label: Fishbone, paging and Milestone focus
components.behavior: The owned roadmap projection separates finite and recurring Tasks, direct Tasks, child Goals and Habits. The browser renders six Milestone cards per page and switches layout for narrow screens.

tests.symbol: test('refresh cannot erase or silently rebase a dirty goal draft'
tests.label: refresh cannot erase

components.test_scope: Projection and shared draft behavior are covered here; fishbone SVG layout, paging and responsive interaction require a browser check.

components.label: Goal information: Edit, Strategy and Related work
components.behavior: Goal details and strategy have separate drafts within one dialog. Strategy is plain text up to 20,000 code points; it does not emit Activity or change progress. Saved-version/draft choices preserve concurrent edits.

components.label: Goal progress, completion and ancestor reopen
components.behavior: Progress is the mean of immediate active child Goal percentages, completed Milestones and Done direct one-off Tasks. Exclude Habits, contributions, occurrences and Tasks inside Milestones. Calculated 100% does not auto-complete the Goal.

components.label: Archive Goal and contents
components.behavior: Empty-container archive and include_contents=true are different operations. The latter explicitly archives descendant Goals, Milestones, Tasks and series and removes relevant prerequisite links in one transaction. It is not a hard delete or automatic default cascade.

components.label: Prerequisites and completion lock
components.behavior: Prerequisite edges form a separate acyclic graph and may cross owned Goals. All active prerequisites must be Completed to complete this Milestone. Reopening a prerequisite with a completed dependent is rejected; reopen dependents first.

components.label: Finite/recurring Tasks, weekly selection and Complete
components.behavior: Tasks under a locked Milestone are usable and completable. Completing a Milestone with unfinished Tasks requires acknowledge_open_tasks=true. Recurring occurrences do not enter finite completion denominators.

components.label: Edit, contributions and archive
components.behavior: Milestone edits and contribution changes use aggregate versions. Archiving with include_contents is an explicit bulk action. Contributions never act as prerequisites or progress weights.

components.label: Today, Needs attention and current focus
components.behavior: The account timezone defines today. Deadline/start/occurrence and overlapping UTC schedules are considered; overdue is unfinished with deadline before today. Focus prefers eligible weekly work, then Today, then overdue; Blocked is not recommended.

components.label: This week and weekly summary
components.behavior: Explicit Task/Milestone selections are scoped to the current Monday week. Duplicate selection is idempotent, reorder requires the exact active set, completion does not deselect. Percentages use active selected Tasks as denominator and only compare when a previous denominator exists.

components.label: Year Activity heatmap and factual tooltip
components.behavior: The current browser renders a year grid with a year picker. Activity API facts count unreversed task/checklist/habit/milestone completions. Levels 0, 1, 2–3, 4–6, 7+ are presentation; note edits do not count.

tests.symbol: test('activity levels use the documented GitHub-style display thresholds'
tests.label: activity levels

tests.symbol: test('yearly activity calendar gives every month its own Monday-first week block'
tests.label: yearly activity calendar

tests.symbol: test('year spinner keeps the selected year in the middle and blocks out-of-range neighbours'
tests.label: year spinner

components.label: Habit streak and quick check-in
components.behavior: Habit streaks and daily state derive from check-ins/rest days. Habit-local dates may differ from the account timezone; do not sum weekly targets into a daily denominator.

components.label: Habit cards and New/Edit dialog
components.behavior: Daily target is one completion day; weekly target is 1–7 distinct days. Period/timezone freeze after the first check-in; archive/recreate to change them. Name, description, importance, Goal and Tags remain editable. New/edited timezone inputs normalize supported browser aliases to canonical identifiers. Equivalent input on a checked-in legacy Habit preserves its stored timezone and history; an actual timezone change remains rejected.

components.label: Check-in, undo and streak
components.behavior: At most one check-in per Habit/local date. No future check-in; repeated PUT is idempotent. Undo reverses Activity. Streaks derive from check-ins and rest history, not a stored score.

tests.symbol: test('checked days are checked whenever they happened'
tests.label: checked days are checked

tests.symbol: test('past unchecked days since tracking began are missed'
tests.label: past unchecked days

tests.symbol: test('rest days are protected, never done, and future days are upcoming'
tests.label: rest days are protected

components.label: Missed days and Rest Day menu
components.behavior: A Rest Day can be planned only for tomorrow through local today+3. Today, past and later dates are rejected. A rest cannot hide an existing check-in or create completion Activity. The backend returns the available window.

components.label: New review, type filter and pagination
components.behavior: Identity is owner/kind/period start, with timezone captured on creation. Period navigation does not redefine an existing Review when account timezone later changes.

components.label: Reflections, Save and conflict choices
components.behavior: Reflection edits are explicit-save and versioned; newer typing stays dirty after an older save. Finalized Reviews must be reopened before editing. There is no Notes autosave state machine here.

tests.symbol: test('a late save acknowledgement preserves typing after the submitted snapshot'
tests.label: late save acknowledgement

tests.symbol: test('refresh cannot erase or silently rebase a dirty goal draft'
tests.label: refresh cannot erase

components.test_scope: The linked JavaScript cases exercise shared DraftBuffer semantics, not this page’s DOM/editor wiring. Verify the page flow separately in a browser.

components.label: Refresh facts, Finalize, Reopen and Delete
components.behavior: Refresh rebuilds Draft facts while preserving reflections. Finalize freezes the snapshot; Reopen does not refresh it automatically. Missing historical Goal snapshots remain unavailable. Delete is permanent and versioned.

components.label: All notes, search, sort, grid/list and paging
components.behavior: NotesPage owns loading, selection and read coordination. Browser layout preferences and server search/paging have separate state. Search/filter changes must not let stale responses replace the selected Note.

tests.symbol: test('Q01 only the latest read ticket may update the page'
tests.label: Q01

tests.symbol: test('Q02 a label or page action can cancel a pending search debounce'
tests.label: Q02

tests.symbol: test('Q03 a current read failure remains visible while aborted failures are ignored'
tests.label: Q03

components.label: New note, title/content, color, pin and Save
components.behavior: NoteEditor and AutosaveMachine share the complete editable snapshot. Plain-text content supports inline checkable lines. Custom RGB, pin and labels remain owner-controlled; explicit Save flushes the normal save path.

tests.symbol: test('debounces valid edits and reaches saved only after a matching acknowledgement'
tests.label: debounces valid edits

tests.symbol: test('J14 IME suppresses dispatch until composition ends'
tests.label: J14 IME

tests.symbol: test('J01 a new note waits for both valid fields and reuses one stable UUID'
tests.label: J01 a new note

tests.symbol: test('projection preserves literal markup, Unicode, whitespace, and malformed markers exactly'
tests.label: projection preserves

components.label: Delete and tombstones
components.behavior: Deleting an owned Note also unlinks its Task. A retried create with a tombstoned UUID returns 410 instead of resurrecting data. Pending file deletion is handled after the metadata transaction.

components.label: Dirty, saving, saved and retry state
components.behavior: Valid edits debounce at 500ms and dispatch within 2s of continuous typing. One logical request is frozen/in-flight at a time. Only exact acknowledged content is Saved. IME composition never sends partial text.

tests.symbol: test('debounces valid edits and reaches saved only after a matching acknowledgement'
tests.label: debounces valid edits

tests.symbol: test('keeps typing during a save and sends the latest draft after the first acknowledgement'
tests.label: keeps typing

tests.symbol: test('J02 continuous typing dispatches by two seconds'
tests.label: J02 continuous

components.label: Recover draft, offline retry and session changes
components.behavior: One account-scoped sessionStorage record preserves acknowledged/draft/frozen request state. Validate schema, user, age and size before recovery. Retry exact requests after 1/2/4s, respect Retry-After, pause offline; validation/conflicts require intervention. Clear owned recovery records on logout/account change.

tests.symbol: test('recovery is isolated by user and survives a reload in the same tab'
tests.label: isolated by user

tests.symbol: test('corrupt and expired records are removed defensively'
tests.label: corrupt and expired

tests.symbol: test('clearAll removes application recovery keys without touching unrelated storage'
tests.label: clearAll

tests.symbol: test('J12 recovery of an older revision requires explicit conflict resolution'
tests.label: J12 recovery

tests.symbol: test('J13 expired session pauses timers and acknowledges a committed pending write on recheck'
tests.label: J13 expired session

components.label: Saved-version/draft conflict decisions
components.behavior: Creates use stable client-generated UUIDs. Exact replay is a no-op; stale different updates return current owned content with 409. The editor keeps the local draft until the user chooses how to reconcile.

components.label: Share dialog: invite, permission and remove
components.behavior: Unknown emails return the same success shape but create no invitation. Owner can change view/edit or revoke access. A deleted Note ends shares.

components.label: Shared with me, accept/decline, edit and leave
components.behavior: Acceptance is required before access. Edit uses the Note version and explicit Save; 409 preserves conflict handling. Shared changes notify other accepted participants, never the actor. Missing/revoked memberships return 404.

components.label: Report shared Note
components.behavior: A recipient reports a reason; the report stores a title/content snapshot. Admin review does not grant access to the live private Note.

components.label: Upload, select Note background and remove attachment
components.behavior: Server MIME/signature and size validation is authoritative; attachment limit is 20MiB. Metadata transactions compensate failed writes; deferred deletion avoids mixing file I/O with SQL commits.

components.label: Preview, download, HEAD and Range
components.behavior: Only allowed media types preview. Safe filenames and a single byte Range are supported; 206/416 and HEAD preserve streaming semantics. Path traversal, foreign IDs and symlinks are rejected.

components.label: Tag picker, hierarchy and Notes labels
components.behavior: Names are normalized and owner-unique. Tag moves reject cycles; complete tag_ids snapshots belong to their aggregate mutation. `/api/v1/labels` remains a compatibility API over the same rows.

pages.title: /teamwork — Team Goals, members, Tasks and chat

components.label: Team Goal cards, search and carousel
components.behavior: The browser filters names/descriptions and pages up to four cards (two below 900px, one below 560px). Selecting a card loads one team Goal; responsive layout does not change access rights.

tests.symbol: test('team goal search matches every word in the name or description'
tests.label: team goal search

tests.symbol: test('the carousel shows at most four goals and pages through them four at a time'
tests.label: carousel shows

components.label: Invite, accept/decline, role, remove and completion
components.behavior: Members have admin/member/viewer roles. Team admins manage membership; the creator cannot be removed/demoted by the normal flow. Member biography and factual done/assigned counts are shown.

components.label: Assigned Task capture, status, due/reminder and repeat
components.behavior: Team members/admins may create Tasks; assignment is team-scoped. An assignee, including a viewer, may change only their own status through the allowed status-only path. Personal TaskSeries logic does not run here.

tests.symbol: test('team task payload reuses the Tasks capture fields and adds the assignee'
tests.label: team task payload

components.label: Team chat and polling
components.behavior: Messages are plain text, 1–2000 characters. The open chat polls every 5 seconds; this is not WebSocket collaboration. Chat/reminder notifications are user-scoped.

components.label: Display name and biography
components.behavior: Profile PATCH accepts display_name and optional biography (up to 2,000 code points); omission preserves biography. Save feedback belongs to this form.

components.label: Replace and remove avatar
components.behavior: Avatar upload validates and re-encodes the image, stores it privately and serves the current account through /files/avatar. Queue removal after metadata changes.

components.label: Verification status, resend and change email
components.behavior: Changing email requires current_password, emails a confirmation link to the new address and notifies the old address after confirmation. Never expose tokens in docs or public screenshots.

components.label: Theme, light/dark, scenery and illustration toggles
components.behavior: Appearance is account-persisted. applyAppearance consumes acknowledged preferences; decoration is not authoritative product data. Keep CSS selectors and preference serialization in sync.

components.label: Private backgrounds, Add tile, RGB and reset
components.behavior: Up to 12 owned backgrounds are retained. Upload validates JPEG/PNG/WebP, <=2MiB and <=4096x4096, re-encodes privately and serves only the owner. RGB is #RRGGBB; a submitted external URL/path is not accepted.

components.label: Personal quote, preset restore and locale
components.behavior: Quote text requires explicit Save; theme/toggles save independently. Preserve newer quote drafts while a save is pending. Locale changes UI literals, not stored user content.

tests.symbol: test('every literal interface string has a Vietnamese translation'
tests.label: every literal interface string

components.label: Change password and visibility toggle
components.behavior: Require current password and exact confirmation, at least 10 code points, at most 72 bytes, no NUL. A successful change bumps auth_version and deletes sessions atomically; redirect to sign in.

components.label: Set up email codes or TOTP, confirm and disable
components.behavior: TOTP secret is encrypted and setup becomes active only after a valid code. Email codes are hashed, single-use and attempt/expiry limited. Disabling requires the current password. Pending login is separate from an authenticated session.

components.label: Notifications, invitation emails and Task reminders
components.behavior: Preferences control new in-app rows and opted-in email delivery. Admin report notifications are always created. Personal Task reminder emails require the scheduler and configured transport; team Task reminders are in-app only.

components.label: Completed-hours, overdue-days and retention settings
components.behavior: Defaults are 24 elapsed completed-hours and 3 local overdue-days. Retention is optional; the admin history cap still applies. Changing thresholds changes membership without rewriting Task completion facts.

tests.symbol: test('history uses elapsed completion time and local calendar overdue dates'
tests.label: history uses elapsed

components.label: Search, detail navigation and Reopen
components.behavior: The client derives the history set and filters names/descriptions. Reopen uses the existing Task transition; an old deadline may still independently qualify an unfinished Task for history.

tests.symbol: test('history uses elapsed completion time and local calendar overdue dates'
tests.label: history uses elapsed

components.label: /login — Sign in
components.behavior: Generic failures do not reveal whether an email exists. Password visibility is a shared client helper. Rate limits apply by email/IP and IP; locked accounts cannot authenticate.

components.label: /register — Create account
components.behavior: Registration creates owned preferences/default Areas transactionally, stores guest language, sends a verification link and establishes the normal session. Public registration does not grant system-admin role.

components.label: Logout and account/session changes
components.behavior: Logout is POST with CSRF. Clear this account/tab recovery state and notify other tabs; do not erase unrelated browser storage.

components.label: Forgot password and reset form
components.behavior: Known/unknown valid emails receive the same response. A reset has a hashed token, 30-minute expiry and single-use semantics. Reset changes password, auth_version and sessions atomically; it does not automatically log in.

components.label: Email verification and address-change confirmation
components.behavior: Verification links expire after 24h; address-change links after 1h. The service validates ownership/purpose/expiry before applying changes. Invalid/expired links render 422. Never copy live tokens into examples.

components.label: Verify TOTP/email code or request fallback
components.behavior: TOTP permits the configured time-step window. Email fallback uses a hashed, expiring, limited-attempt code. The challenge cannot be bypassed by loading a protected page directly.

pages.title: Shared — Layout, CSS, navigation and Help

components.label: Sidebar, topbar, mobile navigation and page bootstrap
components.behavior: AccountController renders page shell/bootstrap; page modules load their own data. Keep root-relative navigation, owned session state and existing data hooks stable.

components.label: Typography, themes and component CSS
components.behavior: CSS entry imports tokens/base/layout/components/feature styles. Change shared tokens for cross-app values; edit feature sheets for scoped presentation. Vite serves source in local mode and hashed /build assets for production.
components.test_scope: Manifest/CSP checks do not certify visual rendering or typography; inspect browser loading and appearance separately.

components.label: Dialogs, sections, Escape, backdrop and leave guards
components.behavior: workspace-ui and dialog-backdrop manage common interactions. Dirty/save/conflict flows are owned by each editor; preserve focus and drafts when moving components.

tests.symbol: test('creation drafts include selection and checkbox changes without depending on disabled state'
tests.label: creation drafts

tests.symbol: test('creation serializes a pending write and restores the original controls after failure'
tests.label: creation serializes

tests.symbol: test('only clicks beyond the dialog box count as backdrop clicks'
tests.label: only clicks beyond

components.label: Help walkthrough and first-visit dismissal
components.behavior: Help opens the illustrated walkthrough beside Appearance. Topics/steps live in walkthrough-content; other dialogs/recovery take priority. Skip/Close/Escape/Finish persist account-wide dismissal once.

components.label: Unread count, list, mark read and invitations
components.behavior: The bell polls every 60s while visible, displays the latest 50 and routes invitation actions through sharing/team APIs. Notifications are user-owned; admin report notifications bypass ordinary opt-out.

components.label: Due personal/assigned team reminders and dismissal
components.behavior: Due reminders are derived from Tasks and merged into the bell. Dismissal uses reminder_read_at independently from email reminder_sent_at. Changing time or assignee makes a new reminder visible. Team reminders are in-app only.

pages.title: Shared — Floating AI assistant and proposal APIs

components.label: Open assistant, status and question/answer
components.behavior: The chat dialog queries availability and submits a question. Server-owned context selection and provider calls must not leak secrets or bypass normal ownership rules. Disabled mode reports unavailable honestly.

components.label: API-only proposal generation, Apply and Reject
components.behavior: AIActionService freezes proposal/hash/context versions; Apply revalidates owner, versions, hash and expiry and calls ordinary services atomically. Replaying an applied proposal returns the stored ID mapping. Modify/Delete are not allowed proposal operations.

components.label: Open/resolved reports and resolution
components.behavior: List report snapshots, reason, reporter/owner and date. Resolve/dismiss with response; notification recipients follow report service rules.

components.label: Search users, lock/unlock
components.behavior: Locking bumps auth_version and deletes sessions; locked users cannot sign in or keep existing sessions. Self-lock is rejected. Team roles do not grant these endpoints.

components.label: System Task history limit
components.behavior: The admin can set the history cap (100–10000, default 1000). The history maintenance job applies it in addition to per-user retention. It archives Tasks, not hard-deletes them.
